meta.title: FAQ · המשך תנועה
meta.description: Who the meetings are for, whether you need to be fit, coming alone, cost and cancellations, plus questions about our nonprofit.

hero.title: What people ask us
hero.body: Answers to the questions we hear most before a first meeting.

items.q: Who are the meetings for?
items.a: Men and women who served in combat, in the reserves and after service, however long it's been since discharge. You don't need to know the association or anyone there.

items.q: I'm in the reserves and can't always commit. Does that work?
items.a: Yes. There is no commitment: come when it suits you, and come back after a break. There are three meetings a month, so there is always a Friday coming up.

items.q: Can I come alone, without knowing anyone?
items.a: Yes. After the workout everyone sits down for coffee and snacks, and only then does the talk begin. There's time to meet people. Itai from our team waits at the entrance and introduces first-timers to a few people.

items.q: Do I have to share anything personal or talk about my service?
items.a: No. It isn't a talking circle: we train, have coffee and hear a talk. Everyone shares only what they want to.

items.q: Do I need to be fit?
items.a: No. The workout is built for every fitness level.

items.q: Can I bring a friend?
items.a: Of course. Everyone registers separately, so send them the link to the meeting.

items.q: Are there meetings for women?
items.a: Yes. Besides Friday mornings, which are open to everyone, there are women's evenings for women combat veterans.

items.q: Can partners come?
items.slot: Can partners come to Friday mornings (yes or no, and one line)

items.q: Where is it, and how do I get there?
items.a: Friday mornings take place at Holmes Place in Modi'in. The exact place of each meeting is in its details on the calendar.

items.q: What should I bring?
items.a: Comfortable workout clothes and shoes, and a water bottle. We bring the coffee and snacks.

items.q: Can I change or shower?
items.a: Yes. You can change and shower in the Holmes Place locker rooms.

items.q: Can I leave after the workout?
items.a: Yes. You can leave after the workout, or come only for the talk. Coming for part of the morning is paid as well.

items.q: Is there parking?
items.slot: One sentence on parking and getting to Holmes Place, Modi'in

items.q: How much does it cost?
items.a: The price is in the details of each meeting on the calendar.

items.q: Is there a reminder before the meeting?
items.a: Yes. Everyone who registers gets a reminder two days before the meeting.

items.q: How do I cancel or change my registration?
items.a: With the personal link you get at the end of registration. Canceling early frees your spot for someone on the waiting list.

items.q: What happens to the details I fill in?
items.a: They are used only to manage registration and attendance and to get back to you. Only our team sees them. They are never sold or passed on.

items.q: Do you take photos at meetings?
items.a: Sometimes, for our pages. If you'd rather not appear in published photos, check the box on the registration form and our team will see it.

items.q: What is {org}?
items.a: A nonprofit that's a home for combat veterans after their service. We hold regular meetings, and we're building a nationwide network of local community centers.

items.q: Do I need to be a member to come?
items.slot: Do participants need to be members to come to meetings (yes or no, and one line)

items.q: How can I volunteer?
items.a: Send us a message on WhatsApp and someone from our team will get back to you. You can also offer a talk or a workout session.

items.q: Can I get a tax benefit for my gift?
items.a: In Israel, our application for Section 46 recognition is in process. We'll update the site when there's a decision.
items.aApproved: Yes, in Israel: we are recognized under Section 46 of the Israeli Income Tax Ordinance, so gifts from Israeli taxpayers qualify for a tax credit.

closing.title: Didn't find your answer?
closing.body: Write to us and someone from our team will get back to you.
